g.text: Local-scope controls: available fixed-patch validation observations
Each phase uses its own successful-update axis. Unfinished trajectories stop at the snapshot; no future or missing values are filled.
All four arms retain P and attribute feature fusion. C0 uses static gates; no-GDF arms omit the GDF gradient to S after head warmup.
Y-axis ranges follow each panel's observed values. These are stage observations, not final matched native endpoint conclusions.
